metadata.title: Primitive Betti points over k[x,y,z] and the Heisenberg enveloping algebra: the pure modules U/U(x^e,y^e), characteristic 2, and a census for d_3 <= 12
metadata.description:
Erman and Sam asked whether every integral point on a pure ray of the Boij-Söderberg cone in three variables is the Betti table of a finite length module over k[x,y,z] or over the enveloping algebra U of the Heisenberg Lie algebra. Jiang, Li, Sun, Wang, Xiao and Yu answered the question negatively over every field in 2026.

We study the primitive points that pass the Hilbert series parity test over U and are excluded over k[x,y,z]. We prove that M_e = U/U(x^e, y^e) has a pure resolution of type (0, e, 3e, 4e) with Betti numbers (1, 2, 2, 1) if and only if char k = 0 or char k >= 2e. We prove that in characteristic 2 no module with a generators and at most a + 1 relations of one degree e >= 2 has finite length over U, so the same point is realized over neither ring on the ray (0, e, 3e, 4e) for every e >= 2. By exact computation, the ten rays with d_3 <= 12 that pass the parity test and are excluded over k[x,y,z] are realized over U in characteristic 0.

The census over k[x,y,z] of the 220 rays with d_3 <= 12 realizes the primitive point on 193 rays (147 in characteristic 0 by a cited construction or a resolution over the rationals, all 193 by a rank certificate of the lift), excludes it on 12 and leaves 15 open. In characteristic 0 no counterexample has d_3 <= 9, while two rays with d_3 = 10 are counterexamples over every field. On the infinite family of rays (0, e, 3e, 4e), e >= 2, whether the primitive point is realized depends on the characteristic.

Source code, data and computational records: https://github.com/fsantibanezleal/CAOS_RESEARCH. The paper does not claim a negative answer to Question 6.1 of Erman and Sam, which is due to Jiang, Li, Sun, Wang, Xiao and Yu, and claims no priority for any other result.
